definitionZh: 网格柱-端CSS属性通过将其网格位置贡献一个线,一个跨,或无(自动)来指定网格项目在网格柱内的端位置,从而指定其网格区域的块端边缘.
sourceDefinition: The grid-column-end CSS property specifies a grid item's end position within the grid column by contributing a line, a span, or nothing (automatic) to its grid placement, thereby specifying the block-end edge of its grid areas.
